instruction:
Three Storey Dormitory Wing IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit dormitory wing with a double-loaded corridor on each level and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 24 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcRoof.
5. The IFC model contains at least 24 IfcDoor entities, at least 18 IfcWindow entities, and at least 3 IfcStair entities.
6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token corridor at least 3 times, student room at least 18 times, and bath at least 3 times.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 34.0 m and 38.0 m.
9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 10.5 m and 13.5 m.
10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 9.5 m and 11.5 m.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
